ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixel coverage localized to surface scarring and anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation base across both lobes; high-contrast white pixel clusters appear as circular rings (rosettes) in the central lobe regions and dense linear streaks on the lateral outer lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central base with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch, terminating in sharp, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous white circular pixel rings (approximately 10-25 pixels in diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, most prominent in the lower-inner quadrant of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the mid-to-outer lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white rake mark scarring; multiple circular barnacle attachment scars; visible biological clusters (barnacle colonies) attached to the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Physical clusters of light-colored, high-relief barnacle organisms protruding from the outer trailing edge and tips.
